name: Sentinelle · cockpit privé
postStartCommand:
set -eu
umask 077
python - <<'PYTHON'
from pathlib import Path
import os, secrets
from sentinelle.config import default_data_dir
from sentinelle.api.auth import Auth
from sentinelle.storage.db import Database
folder = default_data_dir()
db = Database(folder / 'sentinelle.db')
try:
    auth = Auth(db)
    if not auth.configured:
        password = os.environ.get('SENTINELLE_PANEL_PASSWORD')
        if not password:
            path = folder / 'codespaces-login.txt'
            if not path.exists():
                with path.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    f.write(secrets.token_urlsafe(24))
            password = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
        auth.set_password(password)
finally:
    db.close()
PYTHON
unset SENTINELLE_PANEL_PASSWORD
nohup flock -n data/cockpit-8000.lock python -m sentinelle --remote --port 8000 --no-browser > /tmp/sentinelle-cockpit.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
